person.roleLine: Backend engineer & DevOps practitioner · shipping calm systems
summaryParagraphs: I have spent the last decade shipping platforms where reliability is a feature: accounting-grade APIs, telemetry ingest, auth gateways, and the Terraform/Argo machinery that keeps them observable and recoverable.
I care about clear boundaries, measurable rollouts, and docs that help the next person at 3am. This site is static on purpose—what you see is built from data in the repo, ready for GitHub Pages.

highlights.heroTitle: Systems that survive traffic, audits, and 3am pages.
highlights.heroSubtitle: I design and ship backend platforms and DevOps foundations: APIs you can reason about, pipelines you can trust, and observability that answers questions before Slack does.
highlights.projectsSectionIntro: Two lanes of work I ship most often—platform APIs and automation that keeps them honest.
